question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute PEX piping for the copper domestic water piping specified in Section 22 11 16 before ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use a PEX piping alternate in lieu of the specified copper domestic water piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: As a substitution request with no cost impact, it is routed to the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer, the design professional of record for the plumbing piping specification.
